text:
dina: heads up, deploybot started rolling `kernel-qv6.0+abi12` in eu-west-1 during late window. canary shows a perf skew on matmul throughput and an intermittent cuda driver warning.

deploybot: ACTION: rollout initiated for bundle kernel-qv6.0+abi12 across region eu-west-1. Canary slice: 20 hosts. (use `deploybot status 1749954321`)

sre-bot: quick dashboard: tail latency +12% for short sequences, throughput down ~18% on canary hosts. driver warnings reported on 6 hosts. link: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/canary/1749954321

mohit: can you paste driver warning? might be the new kernel falling back to a slower cuBLAS path.

dina: logs from host-canary-07:
```
[2026-03-20T22:12:03Z] kernel: cuBLAS fallback: requested kernel not available, using generic_gemm
[2026-03-20T22:12:03Z] runtime: matmul_qv6: selected kernel generic_gemm, perf=0.64x
[2026-03-20T22:12:10Z] driver: WARN nvlink error corrected on link-1
[2026-03-20T22:12:11Z] runtime: serving_error=slow_path seq=512 model=kernel-qv6.0
```

zhen: slower kernel selection could explain throughput drop. Does this correlate with specific GPU firmware or driver revisions?

tara_ops: I see affected nodes are all on driver 525.85.05 with firmware v2.3. Mohit, any known regressions?

mohit: Not known, but qv6 introduces a new matmul tiling that probes cuBLAS first then falls back. If cuBLAS probe fails because of driver ABI mismatch, we hit generic path. This fits.

dina: options: 1) pause rollout and pin back to last stable kernel `kernel-qv5.9+abi11` 2) narrow canary and force cuBLAS compatibility shim 3) proceed and monitor with throttle. Thoughts?

zhen: prefer pause & pin for eu-west-1 until we confirm shim suffices. Latency/regress is customer-visible.

tara_ops: operationally, pause is clean: deploybot supports region pause and traffic pin. I'll prepare the pin command, but want decision within 10m.

deploybot: NOTE: auto-pause threshold reached (latency +10%). Suggested action: `deploybot rollback --region eu-west-1 --bundle kernel-qv5.9+abi11 --reason "canary perf regression"`

mohit: I'll reproduce on a staging node with driver 525.85.05 and log cuBLAS probe. If probe fails consistently, we'll push a small shim that bypasses probe and forces cuBLAS-compatible code path. If shim works, we can reattempt with a driver-gated rollout.

dina: decision: execute regional pause + pin to kernel-qv5.9. tara_ops to run rollback play. Mohit to run repro and prototype shim. Update release notes with hold.

tara_ops: executing rollback now. ETA 7m.

sre-bot: ticket RED-3214 filed: "eu-west-1 kernel-qv6.0 canary perf regression; rollback in progress". Attach telemetry.

dina: thanks. Will ping product and infra leads and add a blurb to the release notes: "HOLD: kernel-qv6.0 in eu-west-1 due to matmul fallback on certain driver versions."

zhen: once shim validated, we should also add a preflight driver-check to the release process to avoid driver ABI mismatches.

mohit: agreed. I'll also add a small probe test to our canary that forces cuBLAS path and fails early if not present.

dina: updates as rollback finishes.

sre-bot: rollback complete in eu-west-1 at 1749954605. All canary hosts back to kernel-qv5.9+abi11.
